title: *CS508 GDB ANSWER*
text:
*CS508 GDB ANSWER*
> 𝐕𝐈𝐑𝐓𝐔𝐀𝐋 𝐀𝐋𝐄𝐑𝐓'𝐒 🇵🇰

Suitable Programming Language: ADA

Reason 1: Ada is designed for safety-critical and real-time systems, making it suitable for aircraft monitoring, emergency alerts, and collision detection.

Reason 2: Ada supports strong type checking, concurrent processing, and modular programming, ensuring reliability, accuracy, portability, and easier maintenance.
